articles.title: Google’s new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media
articles.summary: Google on Tuesday launched a new site that lets anyone verify whether a piece of media, be it an image, a video or an audio clip, is generated using AI.

articles.title: 6 days to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Save on your pass before doors open
articles.summary: In 6 days, 10,000+ people from across the global startup and tech ecosystem will come together at San Francisco’s Moscone West for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. If you’re planning to be one of them, don’t wait to register your ticket before prices increase at the door. Save up to $100 on your pass, plus 50% on a second of the same type.
